# EVA medical_hr record D10.3

A customer-service phone call: EVA's simulated caller (an ElevenLabs agent)
calls the agent under test, which answers by voice and uses the domain's
tools. Validated and graded by EVA's own code.

This task is run by harbor-voice's call runner
(`harbor_voice.harbor_agent:VoiceCallAgent`), which reads the spec below.

```toml
# Generated by eva_adapter.main from ServiceNow/eva@039efa0a.
# The seed is EVA's trial index k (records/<id>/trial_<k>); a job sets it.
task = "eva/medical_hr/D10.3"
seed = 0

[call]
driver = "eva_adapter.trial:drive"
timeout_sec = 9540

[call.config]
domain = "medical_hr"
record_id = "D10.3"
language = "en"
reward = "EVA-A_pass"
num_trials = 3

[environment]
docker_image = "ghcr.io/amoh-ai/eva-main:c168c1f67a@sha256:92dac11ab9ecd6e5e87bbb96c25031618aacd353f442646920c30270b015594d"
build_timeout_sec = 3600
cpus = 2
memory_mb = 4096
env = { OPENAI_API_KEY = "${OPENAI_API_KEY}", ELEVENLABS_API_KEY = "${ELEVENLABS_API_KEY}", EVA_EN_USER_F = "${EVA_EN_USER_F}", EVA_EN_USER_M = "${EVA_EN_USER_M}", EVA_MODEL_LIST = "${EVA_MODEL_LIST}", GEMINI_API_KEY = "${GEMINI_API_KEY:-}", GOOGLE_API_KEY = "${GOOGLE_API_KEY:-}", GOOGLE_APPLICATION_CREDENTIALS = "${GOOGLE_APPLICATION_CREDENTIALS:-}", VERTEXAI_PROJECT = "${VERTEXAI_PROJECT:-}", VERTEXAI_LOCATION = "${VERTEXAI_LOCATION:-}", AWS_ACCESS_KEY_ID = "${AWS_ACCESS_KEY_ID:-}", AWS_SECRET_ACCESS_KEY = "${AWS_SECRET_ACCESS_KEY:-}", AWS_SESSION_TOKEN = "${AWS_SESSION_TOKEN:-}", AWS_REGION = "${AWS_REGION:-}", JUDGE_MODEL = "${JUDGE_MODEL:-}", EVA_SIDECAR_METRIC_CONFIGS = "${EVA_SIDECAR_METRIC_CONFIGS:-}" }

[verifier]
timeout_sec = 1860
```
